pairs.title: Pound in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars £1 buys. A rising number means a stronger pound.
pairs.source: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED series DEXUSUK) · noon buying rate, New York; as published.

pairs.title: Pound in euros
pairs.description: How many euros £1 buys. A rising number means a stronger pound.
pairs.source: Derived from Federal Reserve H.10 series DEXUSUK and DEXUSEU (FRED) on each trading day: € per £1 = (US$ per £1) ÷ (US$ per €1).
